FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 36
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 36 as introduced would decrease municipal sales tax receipts by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the amount of purchases made by Alabama residents in municipalities
that they do not reside in, that petition for a refund from sales tax payments, as provided by this
bill.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) municipalities and the
Department of Revenue to process local refund petitions; and (2) the Department of Revenue to
make programming changes for the accrual of interest on unpaid refunds as provided in the bill.
